Read existing toll rate for restoration

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE name='mover_transwarp'

tests.name: Rig transwarp ship and cargo

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,holds=50,has_transwarp=TRUE,ore=30 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mover_transwarp')

tests.name: Rig exactly one directed warp hop

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps(from_sector,to_sector) VALUES(1,10) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

tests.name: Rig thirty Fuel Ore in transwarp ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'ORE',30 FROM players WHERE name='mover_transwarp' ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=30

tests.name: Clear owned destination defenses

tests.name: Deploy three toll fighters at destination

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,deployed_at) SELECT 10,player_id,0,2,3,3,now() FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector'

tests.name: Deploy homing fighter at destination

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,deployed_at) SELECT 10,player_id,0,2,1,2,now() FROM players WHERE name='mover_transwarp'

tests.name: Transwarp arrival offers toll before movement
Accept transwarp toll and pass
Repeated accepted offer is idempotent
Verify payment, fuel and location were committed exactly once

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id,p.credits,c.quantity,(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector'),(SELECT count(*) FROM toll_passage_offers WHERE offer_id='@{transwarp_toll_offer}' AND unit_rate=7 AND amount=21) FROM players p JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.sector_id=10 AND p.credits=5000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM toll_passage_offers o WHERE o.player_id=p.player_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p WHERE p.name='mover_zero_toll_rate';
